description: Mettler-Toledo International Inc. is a leading global supplier of precision instruments and services, with strong leadership positions in all of its businesses and holding global number-one market positions in most of them, and it is recognized as an innovation leader whose solutions are critical in key research and development, quality control and manufacturing processes for customers in a wide range of industries including life sciences, food and chemicals. Its sales and service network is one of the most extensive in the industry, with products sold in more than 140 countries and a direct presence in approximately 40 countries, and its business is geographically diversified, with net sales in 2025 derived 42 percent from North and South America, 29 percent from Europe and 29 percent from Asia and other countries, and a customer base diversified by industry and by individual end-customer.
